points.K5: 更多支持与本课三大主题

points.K16: 账户申请表与培训资料
points.K17: 查余额有节制，自己要记账
points.K18: 申请活动经费的三个条件

points.S9: 借用实验室，先培训准入

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园社团招新摊位前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of campus club recruitment booths with blank posters and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲学生社团的年度培训。
overlay: 学生社团年度培训：管理、财务与活动安全

shots.scene: 组织结构、钱袋、日历、盾牌四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an organization chart, a money bag, a calendar, and a shield with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 管好组织、管好钱、办好活动、守住安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一摞空白海报，兴冲冲走进社团活动室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a stack of blank posters and walks happily into a student club room.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚当上社长，想马上办场义卖。

shots.scene: 阿杰掏出手机，屏幕上是空白的收款码图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a phone showing a blank payment code icon and smiles.
shots.narration: 他打算用自己的收款码收钱。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，把一本空白的社团手册递给他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and hands the young male student a blank club handbook.
shots.narration: 社团财务小研拦住他：先看看规矩。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 社团办事有章法，安全也有底线。

shots.section_title: 本课是概览，重点讲新规定
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白小册子，封面只有放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thin blank booklet with only a magnifying glass icon on the cover.
shots.narration: 这一课是概览，讲不全所有细节。
overlay: 本课是概览，重点讲新规定

shots.section_title: 本课是概览，重点讲新规定
shots.scene: 一份空白文件上贴着星形新标签
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy document with a bright star-shaped sticker on the corner. No people.
shots.narration: 重点讲讲新出的规定。

shots.section_title: 本课是概览，重点讲新规定
shots.scene: 王老师在教室讲台旁对着空白投影讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands beside a lectern in a classroom, pointing at a blank projection screen.
shots.narration: 具体问题，随时问学校的老师。

shots.scene: 教室里学生们围坐，一名学生站起来发言
shots.prompt_en: Students sit in a circle in a classroom; one student stands up to speak while others listen.
shots.narration: 培训开始，大家先轮流自我介绍。

shots.scene: 四张空白名片卡图标
shots.prompt_en: Four blank name card icons in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 姓名、社团、职务、社团简介。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在礼堂门口，旁边是空白的场地日历
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an auditorium entrance next to a blank booking calendar on a stand.
shots.narration: 注册过的社团，可以免费借用场地。

shots.scene: 校园广场上一排招新摊位，新生走过
shots.prompt_en: A row of club recruitment booths with blank signs on a campus square, new students walking past.
shots.narration: 每学期都能参加社团招新。

shots.scene: 学校建筑图标里放着一个钱袋
shots.prompt_en: A university building icon with a money bag inside it and a small lock. No people.
shots.narration: 还能在学校开设社团代管账户。

shots.section_title: 不私设账户，收入全部入账
shots.scene: 校外银行图标和个人收款码图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An outside bank building icon and a personal payment code icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 社团不能在校外私自开户。
overlay: 不私设账户，收入全部入账

shots.section_title: 不私设账户，收入全部入账
shots.scene: 义卖收入的钱袋顺着箭头进入学校账户图标
shots.prompt_en: A money bag follows an arrow straight into a university account icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 筹来的每一笔钱，都存进代管账户。

shots.section_title: 不私设账户，收入全部入账
shots.scene: 小研把收钱的盒子封好，旁边是空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student seals a cash box and writes in a blank ledger beside it.
shots.narration: 不放个人口袋，不留账外资金。

shots.section_title: 更多支持与本课三大主题
shots.scene: 奖杯、钱袋、对话气泡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a trophy, a money bag with a plus sign, and a speech bubble with a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 可参评奖项，可申请经费和策划指导。
overlay: 更多支持与本课三大主题

shots.section_title: 更多支持与本课三大主题
shots.scene: 欣欣指向三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three blank cards on an easel.
shots.narration: 这一课讲三件事：组织、财务、活动。

shots.scene: 阿杰在年历上圈出新学年
shots.prompt_en: The young male student circles the start of a new school year on a blank wall calendar.
shots.narration: 社团必须每年注册一次才有效。

shots.scene: 四份空白表格依次叠放
shots.prompt_en: Four blank forms stacked one by one into a folder. No people.
shots.narration: 参加培训，再交齐注册材料。

shots.scene: 老周在一张空白表格上签名
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank form at a desk while the young male student waits beside him.
shots.narration: 指导老师要签字，确认愿意指导。

shots.scene: 酒瓶和药丸图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle icon and a pill icon crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 还要承诺：活动远离毒品和酗酒。

shots.scene: 日历上两段时间被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with two date ranges highlighted, one near the start of each semester. No people.
shots.narration: 注册有固定的时间窗口。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，旁边的空白表格被关上的门挡住
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a closed door in front of a blank form. No people.
shots.narration: 开学后抓紧办，过了截止日就麻烦。

shots.scene: 一封信件图标飞向多个社团小旗
shots.prompt_en: An envelope icon flying out to several small blank club flags. No people.
shots.narration: 注册信息会进入学校的通讯名单。

shots.scene: 小研在手机上看到空白的通知图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank notification icon on her phone.
shots.narration: 活动通知、新规定，第一时间收到。

shots.scene: 老社长把一本空白笔记递给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a thick blank notebook to the young male student.
shots.narration: 每年换届，经验不能断档。

shots.scene: 大脑图标里的灯泡顺着箭头传到另一个大脑
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb moves along an arrow from one head silhouette icon to another. No people.
shots.narration: 把积累的做法，传给新一届骨干。

shots.section_title: 怎样交接：交接手册最管用
shots.scene: 四个图标：讲台、眼睛、帐篷、笔记本
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a small lectern, an eye, a group tent, and a notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 交接可以培训、跟岗、集训、写手册。
overlay: 怎样交接：交接手册最管用

shots.section_title: 怎样交接：交接手册最管用
shots.scene: 小研在空白交接手册里贴进流程图图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts simple flowchart icons into a blank binder.
shots.narration: 最管用的是一本交接手册。

shots.section_title: 怎样交接：交接手册最管用
shots.scene: 阿杰翻看手册，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through the binder and nods.
shots.narration: 新人翻一翻，就知道这个岗位干什么。

shots.scene: 校园地图上标着教室、礼堂、剧场、大厅图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple campus map with icons for a classroom, an auditorium, a theater and a lobby. No people.
shots.narration: 空闲教室、礼堂、大厅，都能申请。

shots.scene: 王老师在服务台后，阿杰前来咨询
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits behind a help desk; the young male student comes to ask a question.
shots.narration: 不知道选哪儿，问负责场地的老师。

shots.scene: 日历往前翻了好几页
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip backward several months, with a pin on a date. No people.
shots.narration: 好场地，关键是早预订。

shots.scene: 小研在夏天的日历上标记秋天的活动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student marks an autumn event date on a calendar while summer leaves show outside the window.
shots.narration: 秋天的大活动，夏天就把场地订好。

shots.scene: 三个打勾图标：定日期、审批、排期
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a calendar date, an approval stamp, and a schedule board. No people.
shots.narration: 留足时间定日期、走审批、排日程。

shots.scene: 文化衫、门票、小商品三个图标旁有钱币
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a plain T-shirt, a blank ticket and a small gift box, each next to a coin. No people.
shots.narration: 用商品或服务换钱，就是创收活动。

shots.scene: 社团摊位上摆着空白文化衫
shots.prompt_en: A student club booth displaying plain T-shirts with no print, students browsing.
shots.narration: 卖文化衫、卖票、收门票都算。

shots.scene: 钱袋前面先放着一份空白开户申请表
shots.prompt_en: A blank account application form placed in front of a money bag, with an arrow from form to bag. No people.
shots.narration: 筹款之前，先开好代管账户。

shots.scene: 小研把申请表交给王老师，王老师盖章
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank form to the safety administrator, who stamps it.
shots.narration: 申请表按流程交学校审批。

shots.scene: 财务部门窗口，阿杰排队
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits at a finance office service window with a blank sign.
shots.narration: 账户的事，统一到财务部门办。

shots.scene: 学生事务办公室门口，三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Next to a student affairs office door, three icons are crossed out: a balance check, a cash deposit, and a payment request. No people.
shots.narration: 学生事务办公室不查余额、不收钱。

shots.section_title: 账户申请表与培训资料
shots.scene: 一张空白账户申请表，几个空白栏目被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank account application form with several empty fields highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 申请表写清资金来源、用途和限制。
overlay: 账户申请表与培训资料

shots.section_title: 账户申请表与培训资料
shots.scene: 电子邮件图标附着讲义和测验图标
shots.prompt_en: An email icon with attached icons of a slide handout and a quiz sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 培训讲义和测验，会发到通讯名单。

shots.section_title: 查余额有节制，自己要记账
shots.scene: 查询余额的申请表上有日历图标，只勾一次
shots.prompt_en: A blank balance inquiry form with a calendar icon showing a single check mark for the semester. No people.
shots.narration: 向财务查余额，别频繁申请。
overlay: 查余额有节制，自己要记账

shots.section_title: 查余额有节制，自己要记账
shots.scene: 小研在空白账本上逐笔记账
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes entries line by line in a blank ledger with a calculator.
shots.narration: 社团财务要自己记清每一笔。

shots.section_title: 查余额有节制，自己要记账
shots.scene: 账本和财务回单图标之间打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ledger icon and a bank statement icon with a matching green check between them. No people.
shots.narration: 查询结果只用来核对。

shots.section_title: 申请活动经费的三个条件
shots.scene: 学生会大厅里，经费钱袋分成几份
shots.prompt_en: A money bag icon divided into several smaller bags flowing to different club flags. No people.
shots.narration: 学生会负责给社团分配活动经费。
overlay: 申请活动经费的三个条件

shots.section_title: 申请活动经费的三个条件
shots.scene: 三个图标依次打勾：培训证书、预算表、注册表
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each get a green check: a training certificate, a budget form, and a registration form. No people.
shots.narration: 完成培训、交预算、完成注册。

shots.section_title: 申请活动经费的三个条件
shots.scene: 日历上培训时间和预算时间对齐
shots.prompt_en: Two blank calendar strips line up, a training date matching a budget planning date. No people.
shots.narration: 培训时间会和预算周期对齐。

shots.scene: 代管账户图标周围五个小图标
shots.prompt_en: An account icon surrounded by five small icons: a magnifier, a deposit arrow, an invoice, a request form, and a receipt. No people.
shots.narration: 查余额、存款、付账、申请资金、报销。

shots.scene: 账户图标盖上批准印章后才亮起
shots.prompt_en: An account icon lights up only after an approval stamp is pressed on it. No people.
shots.narration: 账户批准后，交易才能办理。

shots.scene: 一张空白账单飘来，账户图标是空的，阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head holding a blank vendor bill, next to an empty account icon with a question mark.
shots.narration: 没开户就办活动，账单都没法付。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起四根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four fingers.
shots.narration: 垫付的钱想报销，要满足四个条件。

shots.scene: 个人钱包替社团付款，旁边一张收据
shots.prompt_en: A personal wallet icon paying for club supplies, with a blank receipt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 确实替社团垫付，并有原始收据。

shots.scene: 空白会议纪要上有举手投票图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank meeting minutes sheet with a raised hands voting icon and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这笔采购，经社团会议同意。

shots.scene: 账户图标里的钱币足够
shots.prompt_en: An account icon filled with enough coins next to a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 社团账上的钱，足够支付。

shots.scene: 收据上用荧光笔涂抹的图标被打叉，用笔圈出的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two blank receipt icons: one smeared with a highlighter crossed out with a red X, one with items circled in pen with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 收据别用荧光笔涂，用笔圈出来。

shots.scene: 小研在收据背面写字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on the back of a blank receipt at a desk.
shots.narration: 写上姓名、学号、社团和联系地址。

shots.scene: 电脑上空白的个人信息页，地址栏被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen with a blank profile page and an address field highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 学校系统里的地址也要及时更新。

shots.scene: 一张完整干净的收据，日期和金额处被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A clean intact blank receipt with the date area and total area circled. No people.
shots.narration: 收据要原件，有日期和总额。

shots.scene: 洗衣机旁一张皱巴巴模糊的收据，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A crumpled faded receipt next to a washing machine icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 揣在兜里洗糊了，就没法报销。

shots.scene: 日历上购买日后面几格被标出
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a purchase date and a short deadline range highlighted after it. No people.
shots.narration: 买完尽快交，别拖过规定时限。

shots.scene: 购物车里个人零食和社团物品混在一起，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shopping cart icon mixing personal snacks with club supplies, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 个人东西和社团物品别一起结账。

shots.scene: 两张收据分开，一张是社团的
shots.prompt_en: Two separate blank receipts side by side, one with a club flag icon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 分开付款，账目一眼就能看清。

shots.section_title: 报销系统与收款人信息
shots.scene: 老周在电脑前填写空白的报销页面
shots.prompt_en: The older man fills in a blank expense form on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 老师报销，在学校的报销系统里提交。
overlay: 报销系统与收款人信息

shots.section_title: 报销系统与收款人信息
shots.scene: 一张空白收款人信息表，旁边写着一次
shots.prompt_en: A blank payee information form with a single check mark and a one-time icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先备案收款人信息，只需填一次。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地指着地图上的远方城市
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly points at a distant city on a simple travel map.
shots.narration: 社团外出，先别急着买票。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上填空白的出行申请
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank online travel request form on a laptop.
shots.narration: 出发前，先提交出行申请。

shots.scene: 王老师核对账户余额，对比出行预算
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator compares an account balance icon with a travel budget icon on a blank screen.
shots.narration: 学校核对经费，够了才能成行。

shots.scene: 钱袋很瘪，出行图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A nearly empty money bag icon next to a bus trip icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 账上钱不够，这趟就去不了。

shots.scene: 日历上出发日前几天被圈出，空白表格放进文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with several days before departure circled, and blank forms going into a folder. No people.
shots.narration: 差旅材料和名单，提前交到学校。

shots.scene: 四个打勾图标：收据、纪要、钱袋、社团旗
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a receipt, meeting minutes, a money bag, and a club flag. No people.
shots.narration: 原始收据、会议同意、经费够、为社团出行。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻着一本空白清单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips through a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 差旅报销，再把要点过一遍。

shots.scene: 出行申请、批准印章、材料备案三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in sequence: a travel request, an approval stamp, and a filed folder. No people.
shots.narration: 先申请、先批准、材料先备案。

shots.scene: 原始收据被圈出、私人物品被分开
shots.prompt_en: A blank original receipt with items circled, and a personal item moved aside. No people.
shots.narration: 原始收据、圈出项目、公私分开。

shots.scene: 工资卡图标和信封图标
shots.prompt_en: A bank card icon and a mailed envelope icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 老师报销进工资卡，学生的按规定寄发。

shots.scene: 信封上的地址栏被高亮
shots.prompt_en: An envelope with a blank address field highlighted and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 学号、社团、地址写准，钱才不走丢。

shots.scene: 一本空白词典，旁边几个缩写气泡
shots.prompt_en: A blank glossary book with several blank speech bubbles around it. No people.
shots.narration: 社团常用的名词，要弄清楚。

shots.scene: 免费的助学申请表上，有人伸手要钱，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A free student aid application form icon with a hand demanding money beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免费的资助申请，有人收费代办？

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手说不
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves its paw firmly to say no.
shots.narration: 别交钱，赶紧远离。

shots.scene: 电脑上空白网页，几个文件夹图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a blank web page with folder icons for forms. No people.
shots.narration: 表格和文件，都在学校网站上。

shots.scene: 各校区建筑图标旁有电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Several campus building icons, each with a telephone icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有问题，找本校区的社团管理老师。

shots.scene: 王老师发下空白测验卷
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out blank quiz sheets to students in a classroom.
shots.narration: 最后做个小测验，看看学到多少。

shots.scene: 学生们围在一起讨论答案
shots.prompt_en: Students discuss blank quiz sheets together while the safety administrator listens.
shots.narration: 不计对错，大家一起讲评。

shots.section_title: 活动先审批，责任要明确
shots.scene: 欣欣举起盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a shield icon with a check mark.
shots.narration: 办活动，安全是第一位的。
overlay: 活动先审批，责任要明确

shots.section_title: 活动先审批，责任要明确
shots.scene: 空白活动方案交给老周，再交给王老师盖章
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a blank event plan to the older man, who signs it and passes it to the safety administrator for a stamp.
shots.narration: 活动方案先报指导老师和学校审批。

shots.section_title: 活动先审批，责任要明确
shots.scene: 人物图标上挂着工作证，旁边写安全负责人
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram wearing a badge with a shield icon, next to a blank duty roster. No people.
shots.narration: 每场活动，都要明确安全负责人。

shots.scene: 礼堂座位图标，人数刚好坐满不超出
shots.prompt_en: An auditorium seating icon filled up to a limit line, with extra person icons outside crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 参加人数，不能超过场地容量。

shots.scene: 安全出口标志和通畅的通道
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign above a clear unblocked corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散通道和安全出口，保持畅通。

shots.scene: 小研站在门口引导大家有序进场
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a door guiding students to enter in an orderly line.
shots.narration: 人多时安排专人引导，防止拥挤。

shots.scene: 空白应急预案和对讲机图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan sheet and a walkie-talkie icon. No people.
shots.narration: 大型活动，事先做好应急预案。

shots.scene: 插线板串联插线板的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of power strips plugged into each other in a chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 会场不私拉电线，不串接插线板。

shots.scene: 蜡烛和烟花图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A candle icon and a small firework icon crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 室内不用明火，不放烟花。

shots.scene: 灭火器标志和墙上的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a red fire extinguisher on a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 开场前，确认灭火器位置。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 发现火情，先报警，拨打119。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰对着空白名单清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank roster beside a parked bus.
shots.narration: 外出活动，名单和联系方式要齐全。

shots.scene: 保险单图标和安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank insurance document icon and a seat belt icon with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 办好保险，乘正规车辆，系好安全带。

shots.scene: 一名学生离队走向河边的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaving the group toward a river, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 集体行动，不擅自离队，不去危险水域。

shots.scene: 手机上空白的报平安消息图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone with a blank check-in message icon and a house icon. No people.
shots.narration: 到达和返回，都要向老师报平安。

shots.scene: 义卖摊位上摆着包装完好的食品
shots.prompt_en: A charity sale booth with sealed packaged snacks and blank labels.
shots.narration: 义卖食品，选正规来源、包装完好的。

shots.scene: 自制的散装食物被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of homemade unpackaged food in an open bowl, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 自制易变质食品，不要拿去售卖。

shots.scene: 校内经营要报批的印章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank sales permit form with an approval stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 校内摆摊售卖，按学校规定报批。

shots.section_title: 防范诈骗，守住社团资金
shots.scene: 手机上陌生人发来的转账请求，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A phone showing a money transfer request from an unknown contact, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 冒充老师、财务让你转账？先核实。
overlay: 防范诈骗，守住社团资金

shots.section_title: 防范诈骗，守住社团资金
shots.scene: 小研拨打电话向王老师核实
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the safety administrator on the phone to verify a request.
shots.narration: 通过学校公布的电话当面核实。

shots.section_title: 防范诈骗，守住社团资金
shots.scene: 钱袋锁在学校账户里，个人收款码被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A money bag locked inside a university account icon, and a personal payment code crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 社团的钱，只走学校账户。

shots.section_title: 防范诈骗，守住社团资金
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a shield beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 被骗立即报警，可拨96110咨询。

shots.scene: 空白成员名单被放进带锁的文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A blank member roster placed into a folder with a lock. No people.
shots.narration: 成员名单和学号、地址，要妥善保管。

shots.scene: 名单被拍照发到群里的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a phone photographing a roster and sharing it to a group chat, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不随意转发，不用作别的用途。

shots.scene: 旧名单进入碎纸机
shots.prompt_en: An old blank roster going into a paper shredder. No people.
shots.narration: 换届时交接好，不用的及时销毁。

shots.scene: 活动现场有人摔倒，小研跑过去
shots.prompt_en: At a club event, a student has fallen; the female graduate student rushes over to help.
shots.narration: 活动中有人受伤，先保证安全。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 需要急救，立即拨打120。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone at the campus security desk.
shots.narration: 同时报告指导老师和学校保卫处。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：社团—指导老师—学院—学校
shots.prompt_en: Four linked icons in a chain: a club flag, a teacher, a department building, and a university building. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定逐级报告，不隐瞒不拖延。

shots.section_title: 借用实验室，先培训准入
shots.scene: 科技社团成员站在实验室门口，门上有警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and club members stand at a lab door with a general warning sign.
shots.narration: 科技社团借用实验室办活动？
overlay: 借用实验室，先培训准入

shots.section_title: 借用实验室，先培训准入
shots.scene: 小研在电脑前完成空白的安全培训页面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student completes a blank safety training quiz on a computer.
shots.narration: 先完成实验室安全培训和准入。

shots.section_title: 借用实验室，先培训准入
shots.scene: 老周带着学生在实验室里讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man, wearing a lab coat, guides students in lab coats and safety goggles inside a lab.
shots.narration: 有老师在场，遵守实验室的规定。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现日历、交接手册、场地图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a calendar, a binder and an auditorium.
shots.narration: 每年注册，做好交接，场地早订。

shots.scene: 钱袋锁进学校账户，私人收款码被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A money bag locked in a university account icon, with a personal payment code crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 先开户再筹款，收入全部入账。

shots.scene: 收据被圈出、公私分开、出行审批三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a circled receipt, two separated receipts, and an approved travel form. No people.
shots.narration: 收据原件、公私分开，出行先审批。

shots.scene: 盾牌、安全出口、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shield, an emergency exit sign and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 活动先审批，通道畅通，防火防骗。

shots.scene: 电话图标连着老师和保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon linked to a teacher icon and a campus security icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出了状况，及时报告，及时求助。

shots.scene: 欣欣在社团招新摊位前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy club booth with blank posters.
shots.narration: 社团办得好，安全少不了，下次见！
